name: coldleads
description: B2B outreach CRM: import and verify contacts, prepare campaigns that send only after your approval, work replies and follow-ups.

interface.longDescription:
Cold Leads is a B2B outreach CRM. Connect your Cold Leads account and ask ChatGPT to work your pipeline:

- Import prospects you already have (pasted lists or parsed CSV rows); duplicates and do-not-contact addresses are skipped, and importing never sends e-mail.
- Verify e-mail addresses (syntax, disposable domains, role addresses, MX; the mailbox itself only when the recipient's server can be reached).
- Write templates and prepare campaign drafts with a recipient estimate. Campaigns and single messages are sent from your connected mailbox, and only after you approve the exact recipients and text.
- See who replied and is waiting for an answer, which follow-ups are due, and everything known about a lead before you act.
- Schedule the next step for a contact, and read an audit log of every call.

Cold Leads has no third-party lead database and does not enrich contacts: you bring the leads. Opted-out, bounced and do-not-contact contacts are never e-mailed. Requires a Cold Leads account on the Business plan (a free trial is available at coldleads.app).
defaultPrompt: Who replied and needs an answer from me today?
Import these contacts and verify their e-mail addresses.
Draft a follow-up campaign for my leads, but don't send it.
